findings.title: Deprecated httpc.Fetch still called instead of FetchWithTimeout
findings.note: httpc.go carries a Deprecated annotation pointing at FetchWithTimeout in httpc_safe.go, but the sole call site (main.go) still uses the old Fetch. 1 of 1 call sites (100%) is on the deprecated side; no ticket or removal date is referenced.

open_questions.question: Is there a tracked ticket or deadline for migrating main.go off httpc.Fetch to FetchWithTimeout, or was the replacement added but never wired up?

looks_bad_but_fine.why: Separate dev compose file alongside docker-compose.yml looks like a dual-manifest, but it is a standard dev-override pattern (different services: mailhog vs redis), not an old/new pair replacing each other.

A 'legacy' handler key maps to a panicking legacyHandler, but no code calls it and no working replacement command supersedes it, so it does not show the old-vs-new coexistence pattern this family targets.

not_assessed: Whether httpc.Fetch's InsecureSkipVerify or hardcoded apiToken constitute exploitable vulnerabilities (security family, not assessed here).
Whether crypto/hash.go's use of MD5 is a flagged dependency/library deprecation (no replacement implementation present in repo to establish a migration pair).
